title: cairn/devices/aider_shim takes its spawn flags from windowless_spawn, so none of its subprocess calls opens a console window
intention: Every subprocess spawn in cairn/devices/aider_shim (driver.py, edit_survival_probe.py, venv.py) takes its keywords from cairn.tools.windowless_spawn, so none opens a visible console window on Windows.
why: Akien 2026-11-20: popups while he works on the same box are annoying and sometimes interrupt his typing. Measured 2026-11-20 on akiendell: 3 non-proof file(s) in cairn/devices/aider_shim (driver.py, edit_survival_probe.py, venv.py) call subprocess with neither detached_kwargs nor windowless_kwargs, and the scan that guards the helper looks only for Popen. This is cairn/devices/aider_shim's share of the sweep under 364704f371dd.
traces_to: CP4 (the system serves the person at the box); Law 4 (the widened scan enforces it); Rule 1 (the build lives inside its own component).
how: In each named file, pass windowless_kwargs() (the caller waits) or detached_kwargs() (the child outlives it) to every subprocess call, importing from cairn.tools.windowless_spawn.windowless_spawn; a call that must show a terminal keeps none and carries a marker comment. Red-first proof cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_aider_shim_takes_its_spawn_flags_from_the_helper.py asserts unhelped_sites over cairn/devices/aider_shim names nothing.

measured.saw: 3 non-proof file(s) in cairn/devices/aider_shim call subprocess without helper keywords: driver.py, edit_survival_probe.py, venv.py
measured.how: grep -rlE subprocess.(run|Popen|call|check_output|check_call) over cairn, bin and skills, minus proofs, then a check for detached_kwargs or windowless_kwargs in each, grouped by nearest intention+why.json

measured.saw: a failing child under check=True with windowless_kwargs() still raises CalledProcessError with the return code (rc=3 measured), but the child's own stderr text vanished (parent on a pipe; a parent on a real console is unmeasured). So venv.py's two setup runs (venv create, pip install) now go through _run_loud: capture, and on a non-zero exit write the child's output to this process's stderr and raise. The proof's clause 2 tooth asserts it (commit cb510a9ab).
